set.physics.propWash.help: How much thrust the drone loses, and how much it shakes, while it sinks into its own downwash (catching a dive or a fast drop). 1 = the preset, 0 = off. The whoops have no prop wash in the simulator.
set.drone.tune: Fly this drone for real and its physics feels wrong here? Send Andrii your Betaflight diff all, a blackbox log and a few words, or ask for a drone that is missing.
drone.tune.lead: These drones are built from published numbers and estimates. Fly one of them for real and it feels different here? Send your Betaflight diff all, a blackbox log and a few words: that is how they get better. Missing your drone? Ask for it.
drone.hover: Hovers at {full} % throttle on a full pack, {low} % near empty
fb.drone.lead: Fly this drone for real? Tell Andrii what feels different here; your Betaflight settings and a blackbox log let him fit the drone to the real one. Missing your drone? Pick the last entry and name it.
fb.drone.new: A drone that is not in the list
fb.drone.message: What feels different, or which drone to add
fb.drone.placeholder: E.g. my real one hovers at 35 % throttle and this one at 25 %; flips feel slower. For a new drone: its name, frame, motors, props, battery and weight.
fb.drone.diff.hint: Betaflight Configurator, CLI tab: type diff all, press Enter, copy the whole answer and paste it here. It has your rates, PID, filters and motor settings.
fb.drone.log.hint: Fly a minute with the blackbox on (hover, a few punch-outs, flips and rolls), upload the .bbl or .bfl file to Google Drive, Dropbox or similar, and paste a link anyone can open.
fb.drone.log.bad: A log link starts with https:// or http://.
fb.drone.settings: Also send my simulator settings for this drone ({n} changed)
fb.drone.sent: Sent: the drone, what you write and paste here, and your e-mail if you leave one. Nothing else.
fb.drone.done: Thank you! Andrii compares it with the simulator and writes back if you left an e-mail. Your report number: {id}.
